competitors.description:
Bitcoin's implied and realized volatility tell a fascinating story since 2021.

Back then, volatility regularly spiked above 150%. Fast forward to our highs last summer: BTC climbed to record highs and the volatility barely moved.

Even the recent pullback toward $60k only pushed volatility back to 2024 levels before quickly settling again.

Bitcoin as an asset, is slowly maturing. 🤝
